positions.name: MeridianAnalyticsDatabaseSelection
positions.frame: What architectural criteria and streaming requirements govern the adoption of Meridian for the analytics pipeline?
positions.why: Quinton Fairweather and Xena ExpertGH formally pivot the analytics database selection from Zypherion to Meridian due to streaming ingestion gaps, establishing Meridian's dual batch and streaming capability while preserving the Q3 2026 migration timeline.
